findings.name: FINDING: with "选择一份完整会话" the first (earliest) session is already selected before the person picks one

observations.name: OBSERVATION: a rehashed bundle that silently drops one legal past session is NOT refused (completeness is not rechecked against the snapshot)
OBSERVATION: decision=selected with coverage=none is accepted (a chosen session that covers nothing)
OBSERVATION: verified_by / verification_evidence are free text -- any non-empty string passes (human provenance is attested, not checked against B's receipt)
OBSERVATION: freeze time is the machine clock (or a caller-supplied value); a back-dated freeze is only caught by the relative order checks
OBSERVATION: the second selection is not a first-class role in v2 (no 'second_selector' field, no link between the two registries); it depends on a coordinator convention
OBSERVATION: the F-adjudicator role is not modelled; CUR2 adjudicating a prefix that CUR2 selected (primary or 15% second) has to be refused by the adjudication-package builder (B enforces it)
OBSERVATION: the selector page shows the history only in English (no Chinese display layer)
